name: FestiSwitch – Festival & Promo Slider
author: Apurv Bhatt

sections.description:
**FestiSwitch – Festival & Promo Slider ** is a lightweight and flexible WordPress plugin that allows you to display promotional banners, festival greetings, or important announcements on your website.

Whether you want to promote a sale, special offer, festival greeting, or event, this plugin lets you create beautiful banners with customizable text, colors, images, and call-to-action buttons.

You can schedule banners to appear automatically on specific dates and positions, making it perfect for holiday campaigns, seasonal promotions, and limited-time announcements.

The plugin is designed to be simple, fast, and compatible with most WordPress themes and page builders.

Features

  • Add promotional or festival banners anywhere on your website
  • Display banners on top, bottom, sidebar, or popup
  • Fully customizable text, colors, background, and images
  • Add call-to-action (CTA) buttons
  • Schedule banners with start and end dates
  • Enable or disable banners globally
  • Option to display banners on specific pages or posts
  • Mobile responsive design
  • Lightweight and performance optimized
  • Compatible with most WordPress themes and page builders
  • Translation ready

Perfect For

This plugin is useful for:

  • Holiday greetings and festival banners
  • Black Friday or seasonal sales
  • Limited-time offers
  • Product launches
  • Website announcements
  • Event promotions
  • Countdown or marketing messages

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/festiswitch-slider directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins → Add New screen.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins page in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to FestiSwitch – Festival & Promo Slider → Add New Banner.
  4. Configure the banner text, design, position, and scheduling options.
  5. Save your settings and your banner will appear on your website.
sections.faq:
Can I show banners on specific pages?

Yes. You can select specific pages or posts where the banner should appear.

Can I upload custom banner images?

Yes. You can upload images directly from the WordPress media library.

Will this plugin affect website speed?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Is the plugin responsive?

Yes. Banners automatically adjust to desktop, tablet, and mobile screens.

Can I schedule banners for future events or festivals?

Yes. You can define start and end dates so banners automatically appear and disappear.
